tool: gpt-image 스킬(Codex 내장 image_gen, ChatGPT 구독 인증)
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: base-color texture to be baked onto a low-poly plaster inspection panel in a first-person Korean residential horror game.
Primary request: a square, straight-on orthographic material photograph of old pale grey-green painted plasterboard inside a humid apartment service passage. One subtle roughly human left palm depression is pressed from the BACK of the plaster, as if a person on the other side has leaned there; the plaster remains opaque and mostly intact. Five shallow elongated pressure ridges with chipped paint and fine hairline cracks, not a painted handprint. Old tea-brown water tide marks in lower third, tiny grey gypsum flakes, matte dusty edges.
Composition: material fills the entire square, no border, palm imprint slightly off center, real scale about 50cm square; no perspective or surrounding room.
Lighting: flat neutral diffuse scan lighting; no cast shadows, no dramatic scene lighting, no baked highlights.
Constraints: grounded restrained architectural texture, high physical detail, no text or letters or symbols, no face, no person, no gore, no blood, no watermark. The hand is only implied by deformed plaster, not a visible hand. Suitable for a Blender material with geometry and lighting added separately.
usage: 들뜬 보수판(SM_ServicePressurePanel)의 앞면 바탕. Blender에서 두께와 모서리를 만들어 구웠다(build_service_pressure_panel.py).
